cautions: The confidence interval is wide compared with the trend, so the size of the change is uncertain.
ranking.name: Water running off the surface
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water running off the surface in the Mediterranean changed by −0.0028 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.0056 to −0.0003), which is statistically significant (p = 0.03). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is a decrease of about 0.0069 mm/day.

ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in the Mediterranean shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.69): the estimate is −0.006 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval −0.033 to +0.021). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
